scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix mobile && npm run install:ai
scripts.install:ai: cd ai-service && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,ai -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix mobile
